objective: Maximize expected competition score under serving constraints; deliver best defensible tested submission ZIP by approximately 8 hours. Top-1 is an aspiration, not an attainable guarantee.

baseline.local: One-epoch C pure folds0/1 pooled 0.7024238010052843; this is not the two-epoch V1 comparator. Reconstruct V1-like paired OOF anchors.

deliverables: frozen per-experiment plans with complete tried set and failures
all seeds/folds and ensemble comparisons, conditional uncertainty
local and beleriand report; no GitHub publication

verification_tier.selection: B/C exposed chain-isolated OOF and CPU runtime proxy; hidden test transfer uncertain

evaluation.primary: official global pooled clipped |target|-weighted Pearson average of t0,t1; candidate contribution to fixed serving ensemble
evaluation.exposure: All existing folds and validation data exposed; additional folds remain exploratory, never fresh holdout
evaluation.seed_variability: At least two paired seeds for promotion where budget permits; report single-seed screens as provisional
evaluation.confirmation: Independent implementation/parity and runtime reproduction. No genuinely unexposed local holdout established; no claims of confirmed hidden-test superiority.

initial_allocation: F versus T causal feature-head study after inventory and preregistration
cheap paired aux-off or ensemble-aware head objective if distinct from prior tested recipes
one representation/architecture or training alternative selected from independent audit after cheap feasibility checks
promotion: Each attempt freezes exact model, input provenance, comparator, checkpoint rule, seeds/folds, blend, spending gate and stopping rule before outcomes. Default useful serving-delta allocation gate +0.0003 pooled with both folds nonnegative; fixed small screens may be explicitly registered as lower-confidence spend decisions. Final artifact selection weighs robustness and measured serving cost, not best single seed.
allowed: Local/SSH code changes in isolated creative workcopy
training/inference on beleriand using available resources without interrupting existing jobs
local commits and direct SSH synchronization
forbidden: GitHub push, PR or research upload
public leaderboard submission or messages to organizers without later explicit instruction
mutate original dirty worktree or existing immutable checkpoints/results
test-label access, future leakage, hidden scoring-mask inference inputs
leave training running beyond deadline without reporting
stop_and_rollback: Reject leakage, invalid metric, stream reset failure, nonfinite predictions or incompatible package regardless of score
Stop individual branch at its preregistered failure/spend gate; preserve all attempts
After 3 failed mechanisms reframe using recorded residuals instead of blind sweeps
Reserve known-good V1 fallback if no new candidate is credible or serving-safe
By deadline stop own remaining jobs cleanly, preserve artifacts, deliver best validated ZIP and limitations
assumptions: User authorizes autonomous bounded local/SSH research and delivery, not a guarantee of ranking or external submission
Resource capacity is shared; inspect process ownership and headroom before allocating GPU jobs
